scope: Pre-implementation mathematical review only; no real-data enumeration
image_proof: For d=(ri-rj)+nL and q=(ri-rj)L^-1, dL^-1=q+n. If norm2(d)<=R, each component of d is <=R in magnitude, hence |q_k+n_k|<=R*sum_l|invL_lk|. Over affine t, q extrema are at endpoints. Therefore ceil(-qmax_k-margin_k)<=n_k<=floor(-qmin_k+margin_k).
sign_requirement: The negative-q bounds require +nL distance convention; saved neighbor images in ri-rj-imageL have the opposite sign.
quadratic_requirement: Use exact rational min/max from endpoints plus any in-range vertex, including equality/tangency.
scope_limits: Ideal saved geometry only; no compiled query or floating native radial certificate
All ordered pairs including nonzero self images; exclude only zero-image i=j explicitly
Count complete image enclosure before analysis and reject cap overflow without truncation
